tags.name: Großer Plöner See - Badestelle Bosau
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 663870643 ('Großer Plöner See - Bosau', source dive-links.com, tagged verified=no); matches taucher.net 'Plöner See - Camping Bosau' position 54.1015636,10.4255747 (~25 m). tags.name: Großer Plöner See - TVA Bosau
tags.qa_note: coords = taucher.net published position for 'Plöner See Stadtbeck' (54.1210641,10.4062217); identified with 7oceans 'TVA Bosau' because both describe the WWII torpedo/rocket test-site ruins entered via the youth-centre grounds (djo, Stadtbeker Straße). Historical claims limited to what 7oceans and taucher.net both state (WWII test facility for torpedo/rocket propulsion); the V1 claim and company name appear in only one source each and are omitted.

tags.name: Schweriner See - Raben Steinfeld
tags.qa_note: coords = OSM way 69630041 (pier 'Sportboothafen Süduferperle', Raben Steinfeld) - taucher.net describes the entry through shallow water to the jetty of the dive base on this campground; not a dive-site node. tags.name: Schweriner See - Lastensegler
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 3494799485 (historic=wreck, scuba_diving:depth=17); reverse-geocodes to Ziegelwerder island, matching dive-schwerin.de/taucher.net location 'near Ziegelwerder'. Depth: 17 m (OSM), 18 m (dive-schwerin.de, taucher.net), ~25 m (200bar, taucher.net Raben Steinfeld review); 18 m used. Length 25-27 m and age (early 20th century vs '1927' in one review) conflict - flagged.

tags.name: Schweriner See - Görslow
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 3494799484 'Görslower Ufer' (reverse-geocodes to Görslow). Depth conflict: OSM tag scuba_diving:depth=8 vs dive-schwerin.de max 25 m; 25 m used (the 3 m plateau likely explains the low OSM figure). Only one web source (dive-schwerin.de) - maintainer may want a second.

tags.name: Tollensesee - TVA
tags.qa_note: coords = Wikipedia 'Torpedoversuchsanstalt Neubrandenburg' landmark coordinate (53.541799, 13.248598); corroborated within ~70 m by taucher.net forum post 2013 (N 53°32.514 E 013°14.974). No OSM dive node. Depth: ruins max ~8-15 m, target platforms ~25-30 m (difomax 25, sharkneagle 25, forum ~30, 200bar ~20 around TVA); 25 m used. Construction date 1941/42 (Wikipedia articles), built by forced labourers/POWs (Wikipedia, 200bar). Munitions: 200bar warns of munitions; difomax says the torpedoes carry no explosives - conflict flagged. site_type wreck = demolished structure + torpedoes, not a ship.

tags.name: Schmaler Luzin - Luzinfähre
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 2600909804 'Tauchspot Luzinhalle Schmaler Luzin' (matches OSM ferry_terminal 'Luzinfähre' node 432459973 within a few metres). Depth: ~18 m near the ferry crossing (unterwasserwelt.de); lake max 33.5-34 m (Wikipedia, 200bar). Permit rules conflict over time: seen.de (StAUN exemption issued by bases, no night/training dives) vs 200bar 2018 (registration, no written permit) vs taucher.net (no longer fee-based, designated entries only).

tags.name: Schmaler Luzin - Carwitz
tags.qa_note: coords = scubago.com published coordinate for 'Carwitzer Mühle/Badestelle Carwitz, Schmaler Luzin' (53.3007, 13.4316); no OSM dive node. tags.name: Großer Stechlinsee
tags.qa_note: coords = OSM node 8123389515 (leisure=sports_centre 'Tauchbasis Stechlinsee', Neuglobsow) - the entry is the bathing bay directly at the base (seen.de, dertaucherblog.de); not a dive-site node. Depth: lake >60 m (200bar) / ~65 m (seen.de) but reachable only ~1 km out; seen.de avg 4-6 m in permitted area, 200bar accessible ~30 m; 30 m used. Fees differ between sources (seen.de vs 200bar) - no figure given.

tags.name: Werbellinsee - Dornbusch
tags.qa_note: coords = BerlinTaucher.de Tauchatlas 'Dornbusch' (N 52.938611 E 13.716389); taucher.net Werbellinsee/Werbellin page publishes 52°56'19.50"N 13°42'59.00"E (52.93875, 13.71639), ~15 m apart. No OSM dive node. Depth: wreck 28-36 m (200bar, taucher.net) or 29-38 m (BerlinTaucher, bow ~29 m, stern ~36-38 m); tec platform ~40 m, yacht 44 m deeper; 38 m used. Wreck age 18th c. (200bar) vs 18th-19th c. (BerlinTaucher) - given as a range.

tags.name: Werbellinsee - EJB
tags.qa_note: coords = OSM node 3411631022 ('Tauchbasis EJB (Wasserrettungspunkt 1-16)', leisure=sports_centre / emergency_access_point) - the dive entry is at this base on the EJB grounds; not a dive-site node. Depth 14 m per taucher.net. 'Church tower remains' mentioned only by taucher.net - flagged as single-source. Kap Horn (boat from here, 12-16 m) has no coordinates and is described here rather than as its own site.

tags.name: Liepnitzsee
tags.qa_note: coords = OSM way 42431250 (amenity=ferry_terminal 'Liepnitzseefähre', Anlegestelle Ützdorf Nordufer) - taucher.net places the entry at a small bathing spot to the right of the ferry at Ützdorf; OSM has two landings (Nordufer and Südufer way 57770572, ~450 m apart) and sources do not say which, so position is approximate. Also within ~200 m of the Wikipedia lake coordinate (52°45'N 13°31'E). Depth: official bathing-water profile 17.5 m (Wikipedia) vs 200bar ~20 m; 17 m used. Aircraft wreck: B-17 sank 12 Sept 1944 per Wikipedia (citing easydive24 + American Air Museum); largely salvaged - mentioned only as history.

tags.name: Straussee
tags.qa_note: coords = 200bar.de spot position for Straussee (map centre 52.5830167,13.8805083), which coincides with the dive base at the Kulturpark (Wriezener Str.); the entry beach is ~100-150 m from the base (taucher.net review, unterwasserwelt.de). No OSM dive-site object exists (OSM way 38495889 is the dive centre, not used). Depth 26 m cited by 200bar, unterwasserwelt and tauchzentrale; unterwasserwelt notes it is unclear whether this includes soft silt. Daily fee cited as EUR 7 (200bar) vs EUR 8 (tauchzentrale).

tags.name: Helenesee
tags.qa_note: coords = official diver entry on the east shore as published by berlintaucher.de (N 52.273522 E 14.510164); OSM node 920055109 is the dive centre (~0.1 km away), not used. depth = maximum permitted dive depth 30 m per Tauchordnung; the lake itself is ~55 m (200bar, seeloewen echo-sounding) with older claims of 65-80 m. ACCESS: lake shores were closed by LBGR order of 21.05.2021 (landslide 09.03.2021); ~400 m of the east shore released by LBGR on 03.07.2024; City of Frankfurt (Oder) order of 11.06.2026 bans bathing/diving within 150 m of the slide-prone north, west, south and northern-half-east shores. Current operating status of the dive base not confirmed.

tags.name: Senftenberger See
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 663870922 (name 'Senftenberger See', sport=scuba_diving, originally from dive-links.com, 'verified: no'); reverse-geocodes to the road 'An der Südsee' on the south shore where the club grounds are. 200bar.de spot position (51.47903,14.00065) lies ~0.8 km east on the same road. Depth 18 m for the southern basin ('Südsee') per 200bar.de and gerd-dietel.de. Wreck depth conflict: 200bar 8-10 m vs gerd-dietel 11 m; vessel described as 'small passenger ship' (200bar) vs 'Elbe ferry' (gerd-dietel) - type left unresolved.

tags.name: Arendsee - Ostufer
tags.qa_note: coords = 200bar.de spot position (map centre 52.8900667,11.4978), which reverse-geocodes to the Segler-Club marina on the east shore (Lindenstraße/Seepromenade); ArendseeVO places the Tauchclub entry between jetties 53 and 54 next to the Segler-Club jetties 50-53. OSM node 663870945 ('Arendsee', source ENDA SeeDABa) is a lake-centre point, not an entry, and was not used. Depth = lake maximum, cited as 49.5 m (taucher.net 2004), ~50 m (200bar) and 52 m (taucher.net 2011); depth reachable from this entry not documented. Other legal entries (Schrampe/Regattaverein, Kaskade) have no published coordinates and are not included as sites. Depth is the lake maximum (no site-specific depth documented); rated Advanced per the >30 m depth rule.

tags.name: Arendsee - Wrack Patrouillenboot
tags.qa_note: coords from taucher.net report (29.08.2011) '52° 53`127 Nord 11° 29` 235 Ost' converted from degrees-decimal-minutes to 52.88545, 11.48725; reverse-geocodes near the Gustaf-Nagel-Areal on the south-east shore, consistent with Volksstimme's mention of the original entry at the Nagelweg. Depth 16 m from the same single report (no second source). Patrol-boat identity: 'former patrol boat sunk in 2006' (Volksstimme) and 'NVA patrol boat' (taucher.net) - NVA origin is single-source. Access: nearest official VO entries are too far to reach with normal gear (Volksstimme 2014); jetty of Hotel 'Deutsches Haus' used under a county exemption granted orally (2014) - current status unverified.

tags.name: Hufeisensee
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 663870891 (name 'Hufeisensee', sport=scuba_diving, from dive-links.com, 'verified: no'); 200bar.de spot position is 51.46196,12.02536 (~0.8 km south), and the club entry is at Schkeuditzer Str. 70 - exact entry position not independently confirmed. Depth: divers cite 28 m in the old coal pit (200bar, ichthyo); Wikipedia gives 26 m. Contamination: vinyl chloride/LHKW - city kept bathing ban in Jan 2025 (dubisthalle.de); Wikipedia (citing MDR, June 2025) says ban lifted after re-testing but city still advises against bathing. No explicit diving ban found; MDR article could not be opened.

tags.name: Geiseltalsee - Stöbnitz
tags.qa_note: coords from taucher.net dive-site entry 'Geiseltalsee, Stöbnitz (Mücheln)' (51.3187983, 11.8214393); reverse-geocodes to the Tauchzentrum Geiseltal at Strandallee 1 on the campsite, above the beach entries (divers are shuttled to the water). Max depth 78 m per taucher.net; lake depth cited as ~80 m (geiseltalsee.com). Shore training area at Einstieg 1 has platforms at 7.5/12.5/20 m (taucher.net 2014 report); deep water mainly via boat entries. Advanced due to depths to 78 m being part of the site; beginners use Einstieg 1.

tags.name: Geiseltalsee - Frankleben
tags.qa_note: coords from taucher.net dive-site entry 'Geiseltalsee, Braunsbedra/Frankleben' (51.3115693, 11.9203591); reverse-geocodes to the Tauchbasis at Naundorfer Straße 17, Frankleben, on the east shore; entry <100 m from the base. tags.name: Goitzsche

tags.name: Kulkwitzer See - Einstieg E1 Göhrenz

tags.name: Kulkwitzer See - Einstieg E2 Lausen

tags.name: Kulkwitzer See - Einstieg E3 Campingplatz

tags.name: Cospudener See

tags.name: Steinbruch Ammelshain

tags.name: Steinbruch Horka

tags.name: Sundhäuser See - Einstieg 1 Ponton

Charlotte I depth 12-15 m (actionsport gives 14 m on the wreck page).

tags.name: Sundhäuser See - Einstieg 3
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 7671384191 ('Taucheinstieg 3'). Lake depth sources: 30-35 m taucher.net, 31 m actionsport, 32 m ichthyo (Oasis area), 38 m seen.de; site depth set to 30 m. OSM entries 'Taucheinstieg 4'/'5' lie outside the Sundhäuser See polygon (way 4598684, bbox lon 10.807-10.823) and were not used; the Oasis base entries have no coordinates. Charlotte III depth conflict: 21 m (actionsport) vs ~13 m (unterwasserwelt; possibly the top of the wreck); date 12.04.2008 in both actionsport and OSM tag. site_type wreck because Charlotte III is the main target from this entry.

tags.name: Edersee - Tauchzone Berich
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM way 430691944 ('Tauchzone 1 (Berich)', seamark restricted_area polygon; centroid from export). All depths vary with the reservoir level.

tags.name: Edersee - Tauchzone Sitte
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 663870579 ('Edersee: Tauchzone II (Sitte)', dive-links import tagged unverified). Cross-checked: OSM parking relation 5261049 'Tauchzone II (Sitte)' at 51.20083, 9.06095 (~40 m away), matching the base's description (parking, cross the road, stairs). Depth: slope to 36 m (tauchbasisedersee, 200bar), riverbed 37 m, 34 m at full level (edersee-tauchen); all at full level. Advanced: terraced slope reaches 30+ m quickly and the zone boundary is easy to cross. 'Rutsche' is a second entry into the same zone ~300 m away, without coordinates, so it is described in the markdown.

tags.name: Diemelsee
tags.qa_note: coords from the map POI of sauerland-seen.de (Taucherbucht Diemelsee, 51.375452,8.729278); OSM node 663870583 (dive-links import, rounded 51.375/8.725, tagged verified=no) is ~300 m away and was not used. Depth: diemelsee.de 30 m max; 200bar 37 m at full reservoir level, typical dives ~15 m; TSG Olsberg up to 16 m; one taucher.net review ~13 m. 30 m used. Permit conflict: diemelsee.de says no special permission needed, sauerland-seen.de says high qualification demands (nature reserve).

tags.name: Möhnesee
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM way 23244040 'Alter Steinbruch' (sport=scuba_diving); DLRG Westfalen names the dive area 'Alter Steinbruch' in Delecke. Separate dive-links node 663870568 (verified=no, 51.4795/8.0813) not used. Depth: 28 m at full water level (buddycheck), >25 m (taucher.net), ~28 m quarry wall (200bar), 20 m (TSG Olsberg), 15 m (Bubblemaker). 25 m used. Fees/hours vary between sources and years (day pass EUR 5-5.50, 10-entry card EUR 50-70) - not quoted in the page.

tags.name: Sorpesee - Sommertauchplatz
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM way 679301139 'Sorpesee Sommertauchplatz'. Depth 26 m at full reservoir level (MyDiveGuide/scubago); lake overall up to 40 m (TSG Olsberg). Walk from parking: ~120 m (taucher.net) vs ~200 m downhill (ichthyo) - flagged. Season April-November from TSG Olsberg only.

tags.name: Sorpesee - Wintertauchplatz
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM way 679301140 'Sorpesee - Wintertauchplatz'. Depth ~34 m at full level (MyDiveGuide/scubago); TSG Olsberg gives up to 40 m for the lake. Steep wall reached after a short swim -> Advanced. Season Nov-March per TSG Olsberg.

tags.name: Fühlinger See
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 663870546 'Fühlinger See 5: Sporttauchen' (source tag: Satzung 27.04.2011). Depth: 15 m (200bar, Förderverein), 15-17 m (ATC), up to 18 m (Stadt Köln). Stadt Köln (current) allows diving in lakes 4, 5 and 6 (except the swimming area); older club/200bar sources say lake 5 only - flagged. Fees from Stadt Köln valid from 1 April 2025, not quoted in the page.

tags.name: Blauer See Ratingen
tags.qa_note: coords = lake centroid from wikipedia (de: Blauer See (Ratingen)); no OSM dive object found. Single-site lake. Depth: 15 m (200bar, taucher.net) vs 'up to 10 m' (Wikipedia, which notes the often-cited 35 m is the quarry depth, not water depth) - flagged. Taucher.net reviews mostly from 2013; 200bar data from 2015; the lake's own site (2026) lists diving with an on-site school at weekends. Cave mention comes from a single taucher.net review and is unverified.

tags.name: Blausteinsee
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 778561893 'Blausteinsee' (sport=scuba_diving) at the single official diver entry; platform/cabin nodes 11999217846-50 and 11999217847 are features of this entry, not separate sites. Depth: 40 m now, 42 m at complete filling (VWV/200bar), ~41 m (VWV FAQ). Only one official entry per VWV FAQ -> single site. The slope from the entry is gradual (6 m at 15 m, 12 m at 30 m), but Tauchteam MG says >25 m is reached fairly quickly; rated Advanced per the >30 m depth rule.

tags.name: Wassersportsee Zülpich
tags.qa_note: coords = lake centroid from wikipedia (de: Wassersportsee Zülpich); no OSM dive object found. Single designated zone (entry between Seebühne and surf school per TSC rules). Depth: 40 m (TSC Zülpich) vs 38 m (taucher.net); Wikipedia gives no depth. Diving restricted to TSC Zülpich members and approved guests. Taucher.net reviews date 2004-2011, so attractions and fees may be outdated - fees not quoted.

tags.name: Rursee - Bank 1
tags.qa_note: coords from OSM node 12050342728 'Bank 1' (scuba_diving:entry=stair; stair way 183692767 at same spot). TSV NRW meeting point 50°38'49"N 6°24'47"E is ~0.5 km NE. Depth: DUC Düren slate plateau ~15 m then near-vertical wall to ~48 m; AUC says 40 m reached quickly; taucher.net gives lake max 65 m. 48 used.
